usageNotes: Returns a plain-text diagnostic report for the specified PDM node, similar to the output of `pvereport` on PVE; useful for support bundles, health checks, and auditing node configuration. Requires the `System.Audit` privilege on the `system/status` ACL path. The response is a raw string (not JSON-structured), so parse or display it as-is.

examples.summary: Fetch the system report for a PDM node named 'pdm01'

tips: Pass 'localhost' as the node value to target the PDM host you are directly connected to without knowing its registered node name.
The returned string can be large; when storing for support use, pipe it to a file rather than holding it in memory.
API tokens are accepted (allowtoken: true), so a read-only audit token with System.Audit is sufficient — no user session required.
